Upload account rates

One Excel or CSV file for every room type, meal plan, occupancy and season.

Columns: Season · From · To · Room type · Meal plan (EP, CP, MAP, AP) · Single · Double · Triple · Extra adult · Child. Rates are before GST. The file is checked before anything is saved: missing occupancies, overlapping dates and a rate below ₹1,500 are listed for you to fix.

Check before saving
  • Room types and meal plans must exist in Setup (RSS-03, RSS-05)
  • No two seasons of the same account may overlap
  • Double must not be below single, triple not below double
